verdict.rationale: Jira ships AI features through Rovo, so letting users plug MCP servers in as a client is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows Jira or Rovo consuming user-supplied MCP servers. The only MCP evidence is Atlassian's official MCP server (jira-probe-3), which is the server role and belongs to a different story. Rovo's connections to third-party apps and the Marketplace integrations are adjacent features, not MCP client support.
